title: Pocketwire Personal Account Instant Cash-Out Price List
content:
The price figures that apply to instant cash-outs from a Pocketwire Personal Account are fixed per plan as follows.

| Plan | Instant transfer fee rate (percent of the amount) | Minimum fee (USD) | Maximum fee (USD) | Fee-free instant cash-outs | Card-holder bonus of fee-free instant cash-outs | Direct-deposit benefit threshold (USD) | Direct-deposit instant fee rate (percent) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pocketwire Lite | 1.75 | 0.25 | 25.00 | 0 | 0 | 500.00 | 1.75 |
| Pocketwire Core | 1.75 | 0.25 | 25.00 | 0 | 1 | 500.00 | 1.50 |
| Pocketwire Plus | 1.50 | 0.25 | 20.00 | 1 | 1 | 500.00 | 1.25 |
| Pocketwire Prime | 1.25 | 0.25 | 15.00 | 3 | 1 | 300.00 | 1.00 |
| Pocketwire Onyx | 0.75 | 0.25 | 10.00 | 5 | 2 | 300.00 | 0.50 |
| Pocketwire Summit | 0.50 | 0.25 | 5.00 | 10 | 2 | 0.00 | 0.50 |

### Column notes

1. **Instant transfer fee rate** — the plan's base instant cash-out fee, as a percentage of the transfer amount.
2. **Minimum fee** and **maximum fee** — the lowest instant cash-out fee charged when a fee applies, and the highest instant cash-out fee.
3. **Fee-free instant cash-outs** — the plan's number of instant cash-outs that carry no fee.
4. **Card-holder bonus** — the extra fee-free instant cash-outs for a customer who holds a Pocketwire debit card in active or locked status.
5. **Direct-deposit benefit threshold** — the plan's direct-deposit amount in USD on which the direct-deposit rate turns.
6. **Direct-deposit instant fee rate** — the plan's reduced instant cash-out fee rate, in percent, tied to direct deposits.

### Reading the list

- The minimum fee is 0.25 on every plan; the maximum fee falls from 25.00 on Pocketwire Lite and Pocketwire Core to 5.00 on Pocketwire Summit.
- On Pocketwire Lite the direct-deposit instant fee rate equals the base rate, 1.75; on Pocketwire Summit both rates are 0.50 and the direct-deposit benefit threshold is 0.00.
